target.title: feat: add bridge rich links
target.body:
## Summary

- add canonical URL-only Apple preview sends with `imsg send-rich --url <url>` and RPC `send.rich` using one chat target plus `url`
- fetch LinkPresentation metadata in the CLI process; the injected Messages helper performs no network access
- use a dedicated `send-rich-link` bridge action and action-specific capability so stale helpers fail before fetching or sending
- keep non-URL `send-rich` behavior unchanged for text, effects, replies, subjects, formatting, and attachments

## Maintainer rewrite

This branch was rewritten on current `main`, preserving Omar's feature direction while tightening the public and private-runtime contracts:

- strict HTTP(S), host, credential, title, target, service, and modifier validation
- one eight-second preparation deadline with cancellation propagation and staged-image cleanup
- metadata-only fallback when metadata/image preparation fails; no plain-message downgrade
- accepted images limited to JPEG/PNG/WebP, one frame, 2 MiB, 4096x4096, and 16 megapixels before decode/staging
- SHA-256-bound image descriptors and component-wise `openat`/`O_NOFOLLOW` reads from the real user's Messages attachment tree
- fd identity checks, MIME/dimension verification, and a private 0700/0600 `O_EXCL` snapshot before IMCore sees the file
- balloon construction before daemon transfer registration, avoiding orphaned transfers on archive/KVC failure
- exact `chat_identifier`/`chat_guid` lookup with iMessage preference when SMS and iMessage rows share an identifier
- helper input type validation so malformed bridge JSON cannot crash Messages
- per-architecture Swift scratch paths and `--show-bin-path` packaging to prevent stale universal slices
- docs, skill example, release changelog, and contributor credit

## Redacted exact-head proof

Proof collected on lobster against exact head `8eaa37e` in Lobster Test Group with the branch-built universal CLI/helper. Raw logs are local under `/Users/lobster/imsg-pr-proofs/2026-07-10/165-rich-links-*` because they include chat GUIDs, message GUIDs, paths, and local account details.

- Rebuilt exact head with `make build`, then relaunched Messages with `./bin/imsg launch` using `bin/imsg-bridge-helper.dylib` from this branch.
- `./bin/imsg status --json` reported the branch helper loaded with `selectors.urlPreviewMessage == true` and `selectors.sendRichLinkAction == true`.
- Metadata-only rich URL proof: `imsg send-rich --url https://lobster.shahine.com/ --json` returned success with a message GUID and `richLinkImageUsed: false`; `history`/SQLite show an outbound `com.apple.messages.URLBalloonProvider` row, `is_sent=1`, `error=0`, no plain text fallback row, and no attachment.
- Second metadata-only proof: `imsg send-rich --url https://imsg.sh --json` returned success with a message GUID and `richLinkImageUsed: false`; SQLite shows an outbound URLBalloonProvider row, `is_sent=1`, `error=0`.
- Image-backed rich card proof: initial exact-head attempt against `https://www.apple.com/` exposed a real helper bug (`Could not securely open rich-link image directory`). Fixed in `8eaa37e` by anchoring the secure directory walk at the trusted Messages attachment root while preserving `openat(... O_NOFOLLOW)` for descendant components.
- After the fix and branch-helper relaunch, `imsg send-rich --url https://www.apple.com/ --json` returned success with a message GUID and `richLinkImageUsed: true`.
- SQLite readback for the image-backed row: outbound `com.apple.messages.URLBalloonProvider`, `is_sent=1`, `error=0`, `cache_has_attachments=1`, `payload_data` present, and one joined hidden image attachment with `hide_attachment=1`, `mime_type=image/png`, `total_bytes=19060`, and a hashed `.pluginPayloadAttachment` transfer name under `~/Library/Messages/Attachments/imsg/rich-links/...`.
- Adjacent native poll regression proof: immediately after the rich-link sends, `imsg poll send` on the same injected helper returned a Polls message GUID and options; `history` decoded it as `kind=created`, `event=imessage.poll.created`, with the expected options and Polls balloon bundle identifier.

## Verification

- `make build` passed on `8eaa37e`.
- `DEVELOPER_DIR=/Applications/Xcode.app/Contents/Developer make lint` passed; existing warnings only, 0 serious.
- `DEVELOPER_DIR=/Applications/Xcode.app/Contents/Developer make test` passed: 426 tests.
- Live bridge proof above passed for metadata-only URL cards, image-backed URL cards, hidden-transfer persistence, and adjacent Polls balloon construction.

Thanks @omarshahine for the feature and the original runtime investigation.
